borders.reason: Authored organic diamond borders; adjacent variants are stylistically compatible but exact pixel seam matching is unverified.
borders.renderGuidance: Use an opaque quiet earth underlay and draw terrain diamonds at 65×33 with half-pixel overlap. Edge masks are authored RGBA transition overlays with alpha cutouts; use placementOffset and drawSize, not an automatic Wang/bitmask autotile solver. Do not expose transparent ground gaps.

wallNotes: Natural banks include two perpendicular facings, corner, end, fallen-log retainer, eroded cavity, ruin and ramp.

alpha.note: Source alpha retained. A few very-low-alpha pixels contain saturated fringe RGB; normal source-over compositing makes these nearly invisible. Do not discard alpha or use RGB-only extraction.

qa.offlineProofNotes: Opaque underlay and 66×34 ground draw. Organic tile boundary patterns remain visible, especially across high-contrast FOREST variants; choose compatible material subsets and transition overlays. No game renderer tested.
